capabilities: Push markdown notes to IMA notebooks routed by folder mapping
Pull notes from IMA into a vault folder
Map vault folders to IMA notebooks with a setup wizard
Run syncs manually, on file save, or on an interval
Resolve bidirectional conflicts with a configurable strategy
extras: Desktop-only (mobile not yet supported). Not yet on the community plugin marketplace; manual install from GitHub releases. The author states the plugin is a personal project not affiliated with Tencent. Pull is plaintext only and there is no delete propagation or attachment upload.
problem: Obsidian notes cannot be synced to or from Tencent IMA notebooks through any built-in feature, and IMA's API has no official Obsidian client.

relations.evidence: Sync your Obsidian vault to Tencent IMA (ima.qq.com) knowledge base via the official OpenAPI.

requires.name: IMA Client ID and API key
IMA desktop app to create notebooks

summary: Sync plugin that pushes and pulls markdown notes between an Obsidian vault and Tencent IMA notebooks via the IMA OpenAPI.
